about_short_description.short_description: Skio ($105M cash exit, $32M ARR, $8M raised) is subscription management software for brands on Shopify.

product.name: Subscription Management Platform for Shopify
product.description: A cloud-based software platform that enables Shopify brands to create, manage, and optimize subscription services for their products.

product.name: White-Glove Migration and Support
product.description: A service that assists brands in migrating existing subscription customers to Skio's platform with minimal downtime and optimized setup.

product.name: Analytics and Custom Audience Segmentation
product.description: An analytics tool that provides data-driven insights and allows building custom audience segments for subscription programs.

product.name: Quick Actions
product.description: A feature that allows subscribers to easily modify their subscriptions by adding, swapping products, delaying deliveries, or applying discounts with minimal clicks.

product.name: Journeys Automation Platform
product.description: An automation tool that streamlines subscription lifecycle management with targeted workflows for promotions, product swaps, and discounts.

product.name: SkioSMS
product.description: A communication service that sends real-time subscription updates and allows subscribers to manage orders via text message without app or login.
